answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny as a result loses 125 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the sonnet decay curve is applied at close, the kernel weight of every idle key falls, and the signal history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 54% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
